title: Chapter 996
paragraphs: Chapter 996
Episode 246. Battle for the Mithra Desert (6)
Gzif, the Tower of Tales.
Kadun's report was finished. Kellyak smiled at the fact that the Bamel Alliance had participated.
"The results came faster than expected. Well, since the Jeokmyeong tribe joined the battle right away, even Jin Runakandel couldn't have stayed still."
Buying time to prepare for the invasion of the Jeokmyeong tribe was not only necessary for Kinjello but also for Gzif, who needed t
ime to rebuild the Tower of Tales and move the sacred grounds.
[But Kellyak, those summoned demons are bothering me.]
"Sribee, and the two demons whose names were not identified?"

Kadun and the Fire Dragon Corps left their positions as soon as the battle between Jin and Shimart intensified. Thanks to Kadun, who maintained a distance and watched the situation a little longer, they learned of the summoned demons. He identified only Sribee's name.

[Yes. They seemed to take no physical damage at all. Moreover, it appeared that there was no specific constraint, and there were circumstances where they absorbed the energies scattered on the battlefield. Those guys were summoned through Kinjello's strange ritual; can such beings exist in this world?]
"If they violate the natural order without any particular conditions, there can be only one person behind them. The witch Helluram ... it must be related to her."
Kadun furrowed his brow.
[That dark, unknown entity doesn't seem likely to play favorites.]
Kellyak did not answer but thought about the witch Helluram for a while. Without the witch's power, Kellyak would not have been safe from Zito.
"Let's talk to Ganesto about those demons. Anyway, from now on, I must focus properly on the sacred grounds and the stone of the devil. As long as no more variables appear in the desert."
Critil.
Shimart was sitting on his throne, reviewing the battle.

Until the sudden summoning of the trio of demons, there were no particular problems. Jin and Luna had shown endless power as expected, but they alone could not push them back and take over the desert.

The variables, Yona and Eltiyet, were the same. They were all deviations within the expected range, just anomalies, and if the battle had continued, the Jeokmyeong tribe would not have lost any technology or parts.
'Those demons ... must be related to Helluram. They were beings that could not be explained otherwise.'
Helluram was active even in ancient times when the Solar War was in full swing. Although not everyone knew her name as they do now, those close to the sun were exceptions.
Even then, Helluram had demonstrated the 'out-of-order' power. Shimart recalled the day he first saw Helluram directly during the Solar War.
'Even then, I didn't want to get involved with Heluram, and now it seems that those who are influenced by him have appeared. Witch Heluram, she's an entity that cannot be fathomed.'
Whether she wants the resurrection of the Sun God, eternal death, or just wants to wreak chaos in the world, she is an immortal who cannot be understood.
Still, the power she possesses seemed to surpass that of Ameris, who was entrusted with the mission of "guarding the boundaries" in its heyday, so Shimart couldn't help but be concerned.
'Heluram, now that her existence has been confirmed, I must meet her once. And if I determine that she can harm Jeokmyeong... she must be eradicated. By any means necessary!'
Shimart pressed a bracelet to display a window.
"Limagas."
{Yes, comrade of the War God.}
Beyond the window, a Jeokmyeong called Limagas bowed his head. A clanless one named Limagas, he was a first-class warrior and 'weapons manager' of the Jeokmyeong, one of Shimart's closest confidants.
"I'm going to unlock the level one restriction applied to Kri's power source. A situation may arise where the Light of Annihilation needs to be activated. Prepare."
The Light of Annihilation.
It was a weapon that could be used only once, in exchange for Kri's power source and the Sun Sword Tetallon.
The disappearance of the airborne fortress Kri's power source means the disappearance of the city Critil, and the disappearance of Tetallon means the War God's glowing heart stops.
Therefore, the Light of Annihilation was the Jeokmyeong's last resort in warfare.
{...Understood, comrade of the War God. I must pray that it will not have to be used.}
"Don't worry too much. It's just preparation for the worst-case scenario of the witch's direct involvement."
{When I saw the report on the demons, I also thought of the witch.}
"Keep it under wraps so the other comrades don't find out."
{Jeokmyeong.}
As soon as Shimart closed the window, communication from Bakarun came in.
"Bakarun comrade, what's happening?"
{Comrade of the War God, it's said that Jin Runkandel has appeared again in the desert.}
Only five hours had passed since the end of the first battle.

"It's plausible they would return so quickly since neither side suffered major damage in the first battle, but to be this hasty even after the demons' appearance... The desert must be vital. Is the number of personnel the same as before?"
{I haven't been able to confirm the exact number yet. Only Jin Runkandel and Baekgyeong were directly identified by the scouts.}
"Then Cheongpungje will come separately. They've probably brought technicians related to the spatial zone. Increase the scouting party; we must find them."
{Understood.}
"What about Kinzello and Jipl?"

{Jipl seems to be completely out for now, and Kinzello is wandering around the desert with the summoned demons. There's a report that the demons are absorbing the remaining remnants of Jeokmyeong's energy in the desert.}
"Those are clever bastards. We will head back to the desert within 15 minutes."
{Yes, I will prepare... Oh, fellow God of War, a new report has just come in.}
"Connect me to the reporter."
{Yes.}
Ting! A video communication window popped up in front of Shimart. The urgent face of a 2nd-class Warlord, assigned to the reconnaissance, was visible.
{I greet you, God of War! God of War, an unusual phenomenon has just been detected in the central part of the desert!}
"Unusual phenomenon?"

{Suddenly, in the central area, at the presumed location of Lafrarosa, a blue lightning bolt has erupted. We are approaching for observation now, but it seems difficult to get closer than two thousand steps with our reconnaissance ship. The size of the lightning is on par with 50% of the output of our aerial fortress's main cannons...!}
Shimart's eyes widened.
'Could it be, the descendants of the Cheongmyeong tribe are already...!?'
Shimart instinctively prepared to give the order. I will go there myself, so the reconnaissance team should not approach further and stand by.
But the moment he opened his mouth, Shimart saw the video communication window with the 2nd-class Warlord suddenly turn blue and blur.
{Kheuuack!}
Fzzzt! Crackle-!
It was the lightning. The lightning that was said to have started more than two thousand steps away had engulfed the reconnaissance ship.
{Kuwelli, fellow! What is...?}

Bakarun, who had been listening, called out the name of the 2nd-class Warlord who had just been struck by the lightning. But the window, stained with the lightning, fizzled with noise for about five seconds before going dark.
Frantically, Shimart pressed his bracelet to contact all the reconnaissance ships in the desert.
There were over fifty reconnaissance ships in the desert, but no one responded immediately. Did they all get hit already? he thought, as a new window popped up in front of him.
{Heuk, huk! Go, God of War...!}

Blood was flowing from the mouth and head of the Cheongmyeong tribe member on the screen. The scenery behind him was completely destroyed. He had barely received Shimart's communication from inside the ship that had crashed after being struck by lightning.
He was the only survivor of the reconnaissance team.
{They... are the descendants of the Cheongmyeong tribe. They spread the lightning and killed all of the reconnaissance team...!}
"I will go there myself. Fellow, focus only on preserving your life until then."
{Understood... Kheuk!}
Crash-!

Suddenly, the survivor's neck was twisted like a scythe. Someone had stomped on his head with a foot. Shimart and Bakarun flinched as they faced the face of the person who newly appeared on the screen.

{Ah, I see. You guys are those experts or something, Kinzelo's biological weapons, right? I've heard about you from the Jin brothers... You didn't summon us, did you? You've even implemented a light-hearted heart in your chest, you've made quite an effort. These disgusting insect-like beings.}
King of the Underworld, Chilto King Beliz.
She was looking beyond the screen with a face full of lust. Soon after, King of Fighting of the Underworld, Linpa, revealed himself.
{An expert... technological advancement... seems like a lot... Daring to follow our underworld clan... Not enough, even summoning without fear... To increase the completion... You're crazy, crazy...}
Beliz and Linpa were mistaking the Jeokmyeong clan for Kinzelo's expert.
No wonder, the underworld clan of Lafrarosa hadn't yet heard about the situation from Jin after the incident at the sinister temple.

So the underworld people had no choice but to mistake the very ‘similar’ Jeokmyeong clan as the expert they had heard about from Jin. They couldn't possibly think that the forgotten ancient underworld clan had appeared on the scene.
Even the thought that Jin had performed the summoning was impossible.

The underworld people of Lafrarosa didn’t hear Jin's voice during the summoning process, and only confirmed that an unpleasant magical energy and red thunder had inexplicably seeped into Lafrarosa's interior.
Shimart stared at Beliz and Linpa for a while, speechless. He saw the appearance of the prime Jeokmyeong clan's kings in them.
No, his intuition told him that they were even stronger. Even through video communication, the energy they radiated was clearly beyond that.
‘Judging by the atmosphere, it’s not summoned by Jin Runkandel’s will. Is it an error in the subspace Lafrarosa caused by the demon trio summoned by Kinzelo?’
Gritting his teeth!
Shimart ground his teeth as he thought of the demon trio.
"Do not dare to compare such crude synthetic creatures with the great King of Underworld, Jeokmyeong clan. I will make you pay for killing my brethren. Wait there, or flee if you will."
At his words, both Beliz and Linpa shrugged.
{Oh, then we'll leave for now. There's more important work to do than killing these crude synthetic beings.}
Of course, that was to meet Jin and inform him about what happened in Lafrarosa. They swept away the Jeokmyeong clan's scouting fleet simply because they assumed they were Jin's enemies.
{Next time, we will come to kill you ourselves, so keep your necks ready. You expert fools.}
Bang-!
Beliz smashed the video communication window with a punch.

"Ha! It's unbelievable. The outside world's technology has gotten incredibly good, Linpa brother. These expert guys, not as strong as us, but they're pretty resilient, aren't they? The expert we were just talking to even looked really dangerous. I even felt something like a thriving spirit. Can synthetic creatures become thriving? Is that possible?"
"I'm not sure... for now... let's find Jin brother. We have to tell him that we've come out."
